text: This staff report is about a matter that the Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The purpose of this report is to recommend that the easterly southbound lane on Old Stock Yards Road, from a point 25 metres south of St. Clair Avenue West to a point 85 metres further south, be designated for left turns only. The proposed lane designation will clearly define lane usage and mitigate any potential vehicular conflicts.

Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Designated the easterly southbound lane on Old Stock Yards Road, from a point 25 metres south of St. Clair Avenue West to a point 85 metres further south, for southbound left turns only.
